stages.title: Survey Taylor means/proportions/totals/ratios ve domain inference çekirdeğini ekle
stages.acceptance: MARKET-144 roadmap S1. MARKET-202 single-stage declaration'i yeniden kullan. CPU float64 PSU influence sums: complete stratum universe preserved when domain indicator is zero; cov=sum_h (1-f_h)*m_h/(m_h-1)*sum_j(u_hj-u_hbar)(u_hj-u_hbar)'. Full multivariate covariance; t(df=PSUs-strata) intervals; categorical proportions fixed category metadata, explicit listwise/outcome missing policy. Weighted total, Hájek mean and ratio denominators/null/degenerate cases separate. No outcome-based filtering of design PSUs. Hand-calculated 2 strata x 2 PSUs, Stata survey manual fixture, singleton census, FPC census zero covariance, empty domains, denominator zero, weight-scale invariances. Declaration bounds retained; no Dataset fallback. Readbacks include design + target + sample digest + table/covariance/LaTeX.

stages.title: Multistage survey design ve linearized regression kabul aşamalarını tamamla
stages.acceptance: MARKET-144 roadmap S2. Split: recursive within-stage PSU/SSU nesting, stage sampling fractions/counts and actual stage weights; then WLS/GLM score linearization with full design covariance and domain df. One-stage MARKET-202 is not a multistage shortcut. Stage-specific FPC; distinguish ultimate-cluster approximation from full multistage estimator; policies singleton raise/certainty/centered/scaled require individual references. Independent two-stage finite-population enumeration and design-based regression oracle, design effects with declared SRS denominator, missing outcomes without dropping out-of-domain PSU geometry, rank/separation and invalid nested design failures. Persistence retains every stage/equation/parameter order. Calibration/poststratification are deferred subgates, not silently estimated.

stages.title: Survey BRR/Fay, jackknife ve replicate-bootstrap varyans aşamalarını ekle
stages.acceptance: MARKET-144 roadmap S3. Separate gates for supplied/generated balanced two-PSU BRR and Fay rho with explicit variance multipliers; stratum-aware delete-one jackknife; supplied design-consistent bootstrap replicate weights. Persist replicate IDs, design/scale/rscales/centering/MSE convention, seed if generated, count/df and complete failures. Never substitute ordinary row bootstrap or generic leave-one-out. Compare independently enumerated replicates and official survey reference output, census/singleton/domain behavior and missing/incompatible/negative replicate weights. Full covariance, design effects with named reference, replicate-work budget, no silent deletion of failing replicates.

stages.title: IV quantile regression ve weak-ID test inversion aşamalarını ekle
stages.acceptance: MARKET-186 roadmap Q1. Initial scalar endogenous regressor + declared exogenous regressors/instruments, fixed interior tau, i.i.d. resident sample. Record CH rank similarity/exclusion/monotonicity assumptions. Moment E[Z*(tau-I(Y<=D*alpha+X*beta))]=0, inverse QR profiles with independent solver/objective/moment audit; inference and weak-ID confidence-set inversion separate gates. Joint covariance and density/bandwidth conventions only for identified interior solution. Disconnected/unbounded/empty grid acceptance sets retained with grid boundaries; no fake Wald CI under weak identification. CH author PDF and Stata IVQR official examples are planned independent fixtures; author reproduction/license access and actual vendor output pending. Initial clustered/panel/weights unsupported until individually validated. Existing 2SLS AR/CLR is not IVQR inference.

stages.title: QARDL için author replication, lag/sample ve cointegration inference ekle

Dedicated quantile-specific levels/CEC/EC conventions, common-sample bounded lag search, short-/long-run transforms with full cross-covariance and denominator checks; source-paper cointegration/Wald scaling and quantile-process tests, not mean ARDL bounds values. Fixed interior finite tau-grid CPU float64 first; disclose model-selection conditioning. Original author demo and independent algebra/solver/Monte-Carlo reference, then licensed EViews14 QARDL run using exactly matching sample/lags/deterministics/density. QNARDL/weights/panel and continuous-process bands remain later gates. Native frozen/restart readback and LaTeX preserve tau and lag metadata.

stages.title: Quantile VAR/cointegration, QQ ve QTE için ayrı araştırma protokolleri hazırlayıp doğrula
stages.acceptance: MARKET-186 roadmap Q3. Preserve existing qreg/sqreg/ARDL/VAR/MMQR; do not advertise lagged qreg as QVAR or sqreg bands as cointegration certification. Stage A source-paper identification and innovation/dynamic target conventions for quantile VAR/cointegration; Stage B local-linear quantile-on-quantile bandwidth/support and joint uncertainty; Stage C unconditional vs conditional/rank-preserving QTE, identification and influence/resampling protocol. Each gets author fixture/source/license + independent uncertainty check before public registration, licensed command vs community/add-in distinction, explicit grid/support/extrapolation rejection. Prior Sonra/kapsam dışı decisions preserved; no implementation promise until method proposal passes.

stages.title: Identified dynamic-factor ve ragged/mixed-frequency forecast protokolünü uygula

Bańbura/Modugno arbitrary-missing EM likelihood reference; each partial observation keeps its date. Separate serial idiosyncratic, mixed-frequency aggregation and news decomposition gates. stages.title: DSGE determinacy/solution ve estimation için bağımsız feasibility kabulünü tamamla
stages.acceptance: MARKET-188 roadmap T3 research only; original Hayır/kapsam dışı decision preserved. Linear rational-expectations equations/equilibrium errors/orderings -> generalized eigenvalue/QZ existence+uniqueness audit using Sims original equations/code as development-only oracle; return no unique solution for indeterminate/inconsistent cases. Native Torch strategy for required decompositions must be explicit, never hidden SciPy integration.
